items.title: Pay the claimed debt (if acknowledged)
items.quote: Für das eine wie das andere bleiben Ihnen vierzehn Tage, beginnend mit dem Tag, an dem Ihnen dieser Bescheid zugestellt wurde.
items.computation: Formal delivery date is stated explicitly by the postal carrier: 'Vom Postzusteller vermerktes Zustelldatum: Freitag, 20.11.2026.' Per the formal-delivery rule, this printed date is the delivery day itself (no days added for postal transit). The 14-day period for payment or Widerspruch is a statutory period under §§187, 188, 193 BGB (applicable to the Mahnbescheid Widerspruchsfrist, §692 Abs.1 Nr.3 ZPO): the day of delivery (Fri 20.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts the next day, Sat 21.11.2026 (day 1). Day 14 falls on Fri 04.12.2026 (21,22,...,30 Nov = days 1-10; 1,2,3,4 Dec = days 11-14). 04.12.2026 is a Friday, not a weekend or public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no extension applies.

items.computation: Same 14-day statutory period as the payment obligation above, running under §§187, 188, 193 BGB from the stated formal delivery date Fri 20.11.2026 (not counted) through day 14 = Fri 04.12.2026, a regular working day in Niedersachsen, so the deadline does not move. The Widerspruch must reach the Amtsgericht Musteruelzen (Zentrales Mahngericht) by this date in writing.
